Essays, Fiction, and the Podcast

They’re related—variations on paying close attention to what’s happening in politics, technology, and culture, and trying to make something useful from it—but they’re also genuinely their own things. I run them all because I can’t seem to stop.

fields.heading: About
fields.body:
One person, many surfaces

About Lawrence Winnerman

I’m a Gen X writer and strategist based in Fort Wayne, Indiana. I spent twenty-five years in technology, including Amazon and Microsoft, where I led the global program team for the Microsoft Store Online. Then I was displaced by ageism and the first wave of AI, the same wave I now happen to be very good with. I rebuilt as an independent operator, served as COO of Blue Amp Media from 2025 to 2026, and this is the most generative run of my working life.

What you’ll find here: essays on AI and work, democracy and power, and the near future; Light Shines Through , the first novel in The Shattered World series, serializing on The Hinge & The Near Field ; the podcast I co-host; and the consulting I do. Kintsugi as method, defiant joy as resistance, a small group changing the course of history.

Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world; indeed, it’s the only thing that ever has.

Margaret Mead
